# ArduPilot：PGFuzz 原 30 条性质的当前审计

## 先读这段：英文术语逐项解释

- `PGFuzz` 是论文给性质引导型模糊测试工具起的名称；这里“原性质”只表示论文历史输入，不代表当前 ArduPilot 已确认或已满足。
- `MTL` 是 `Metric Temporal Logic`，中文为“度量时序逻辑”；它在普通真假逻辑上增加“在某个时间区间内最终发生”等约束。`MITL` 是 `Metric Interval Temporal Logic`，中文为“度量区间时序逻辑”，强调时间区间。本文保留论文写法，同时把当前可监视写法单列。
- `AP` 是 `Atomic Proposition`，中文为“原子命题”；它是公式中可单独判断真假的最小条件，例如 `Mode_t = RTL`。
- `MAVLink` 是 `Micro Air Vehicle Link`，中文可理解为“微型飞行器通信协议”；“可直接观测”只说明消息字段足够判定 AP，不说明整条性质已经满足。
- `RTL` 是 `Return To Launch`，中文为“返航”；`G` 表示“全程都要检查”，`F_[a,b]` 表示“从当前时刻起 a 到 b 的区间内最终发生”。`t-1` 只表示上一条有效观测，绝不是一秒前。
- `InputP` 是 `Parameter Input`，中文为“配置参数输入”；`InputC` 是 `Command Input`，中文为“命令、模式或遥控输入”；`InputE` 是 `Environmental Input`，中文为“仿真环境或故障输入”。这是 PGFuzz 的输入分类，不是 AP 状态分类。
- `SITL` 是 `Software In The Loop`，中文为“软件在环仿真”；表中的当前运行参数值只来自冻结的 SITL 参数快照，配置参数通常可以更改，默认值绝不能当成每次运行值。
- `实现符合性：未评估` 表示本文件只核对要求、公式和源码身份；源码位置不能被当成“程序已满足该要求”的证明。

## 冻结基线与判定边界

- ArduCopter 源码提交：`8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e`。
- 当前官方文档固定提交：`826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd`；本地完整快照较旧，但本文件所用 Copter/Common 页面已逐页确认内容一致。
- 论文 PDF 的 SHA-256（用于核对文件内容一致性的 256 位摘要）为 `bb057be0069e9e764c8fb4bf963b09311cc914f3fb60da0b121afa94c90d7fcd`，公式来自第 18 页 Table XII（第十二号表）。
- 当前规范状态只根据官方说明、参数元数据或规范性源码注释；普通控制流不产生性质。源码只回答变量在哪里、怎样更新和怎样观测。
- 所有参数均可通过配置改变的可能性单独保留；“默认值”和“本次运行值”分列，未进行写入测试时不声称飞行中立即生效。

## 每条性质的 AP、源码位置与作者全部输入明细

下面每个折叠块都能独立审核。源码“主真值”是判断 AP 的直接实体；“形成/消费/发送证据”是更新、使用或发消息的位置。它们只建立身份链，不给出符合性结论。作者输入是高召回候选；除了明确的前置设置，不能写成已证明因果依赖。

<details><summary><strong>A.RTL1</strong>：当前高度低于 RTL_ALT 时持续爬升，直到达到该高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“When RTL mode is selected, the copter will return to the home location, or if :ref:`rally points <common-rally-points>` have been setup, the closest rally point. The copter will first rise a minimum of :ref:`RTL_CLIMB_MIN<RTL_CLIMB_MIN>` or to  :ref:`RTL_ALT_M<RTL_ALT_M>`, whichever is higher, before returning home.  The default value for :ref:`RTL_ALT_M<RTL_ALT_M>` is 15m. Under no circumstances will this altitude be below 30cm. The altitude reference frame is set by either the rally point, if proceeding to one of those, or by :ref:`RTL_ALT_TYPE<RTL_ALT_TYPE>` to select relative to HOME, or Terrain. If :ref:`WP_RFND_USE<WP_RFND_USE>` = 1 and Terrain is selected, then rangefinder will be used. If RTL is entered close to its return point, the altitude Copter climbs to may be limited to avoid unneeded climbs and descents. The :ref:`RTL_CONE_SLOPE<RTL_CONE_SLOPE>` parameter determines the slope of an inverted cone centered on the return point. This reduces the above return altitude according to: distance from return point * :ref:`RTL_CONE_SLOPE<RTL_CONE_SLOPE>`. So if the mode is entered 10m from the return point, using the default slope of "3", then the altitude rise would be limited to 30m before returning. It may be less depending on the other parameters, but not higher. If the slope were set to "0.5", then the initial climb would be no higher than 5m altitude before proceeding to the return point. A value of "0" disables this limit. "0.5" is the minimum slope. Again, 2m is the minimum return altitude.”
- 官方位置：[RTL Mode — initial climb](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst#L15-L24)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst:15-24`。
- 论文原式：`G(((ALT_t < RTL_ALT) & (Mode_t = RTL)) -> (ALT_t-1 < ALT_t))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=RTL ∧ ALT<RTL_target_alt) → ALT_prev<ALT)`。
- 修改理由：当前目标高度由最低爬升、RTL_ALT_M、距离锥、围栏和参考坐标共同决定，不再是论文中的单一 RTL_ALT。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALT_t < RTL_ALT` | 当前高度低于 ArduPilot 返航高度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`ModeRTL::altitude_m / RTL_ALT_M`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp:8](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L8-L8)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |
| `Mode_t = RTL` | 当前飞行模式是返航模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::RTL`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:84](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L84-L84)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::RTL。  |
| `ALT_t-1 < ALT_t` | 当前观测高度高于上一观测高度。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.RTL2</strong>：达到返航高度且尚未到家时，保持高度并移动到返航参考位置。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“When RTL mode is selected, the copter will return to the home location, or if :ref:`rally points <common-rally-points>` have been setup, the closest rally point. The copter will first rise a minimum of :ref:`RTL_CLIMB_MIN<RTL_CLIMB_MIN>` or to  :ref:`RTL_ALT_M<RTL_ALT_M>`, whichever is higher, before returning home.  The default value for :ref:`RTL_ALT_M<RTL_ALT_M>` is 15m. Under no circumstances will this altitude be below 30cm. The altitude reference frame is set by either the rally point, if proceeding to one of those, or by :ref:`RTL_ALT_TYPE<RTL_ALT_TYPE>` to select relative to HOME, or Terrain. If :ref:`WP_RFND_USE<WP_RFND_USE>` = 1 and Terrain is selected, then rangefinder will be used. If RTL is entered close to its return point, the altitude Copter climbs to may be limited to avoid unneeded climbs and descents. The :ref:`RTL_CONE_SLOPE<RTL_CONE_SLOPE>` parameter determines the slope of an inverted cone centered on the return point. This reduces the above return altitude according to: distance from return point * :ref:`RTL_CONE_SLOPE<RTL_CONE_SLOPE>`. So if the mode is entered 10m from the return point, using the default slope of "3", then the altitude rise would be limited to 30m before returning. It may be less depending on the other parameters, but not higher. If the slope were set to "0.5", then the initial climb would be no higher than 5m altitude before proceeding to the return point. A value of "0" disables this limit. "0.5" is the minimum slope. Again, 2m is the minimum return altitude.”
- 官方位置：[RTL Mode — return altitude](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst#L15-L24)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst:15-24`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_ALT) & (Pos_t != home_position)) -> ((Pos_t-1 != Pos_t) & (ALT_t-1 = ALT_t)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=RTL ∧ return_leg ∧ ¬at_return_point) → (distance_to_return_prev>distance_to_return ∧ commanded_ALT=RTL_target_alt))`。
- 修改理由：当前仍要求返航，但“保持高度”是控制目标，不等于带噪声实测高度在相邻样本严格相等。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = RTL` | 当前飞行模式是返航模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::RTL`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:84](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L84-L84)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::RTL。  |
| `ALT_t >= RTL_ALT` | 当前高度达到或超过 ArduPilot 返航高度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`ModeRTL::altitude_m / RTL_ALT_M`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp:8](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L8-L8)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |
| `Pos_t != home_position` | 当前位置不等于返航参考位置。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。<br>主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_home()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:600](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L600-L600)；Home 已设置时读取 AHRS 保存的 Home Location。 要求 home_is_set()；当前 RTL 目的地也可能是 rally point，不能自动把 return target 等同于 Home。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_AHRS::_home, AP_AHRS::_home_is_set`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:857](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L857-L857)；只有 _home_is_set==true 时 _home 才是有效 Home。 Home 可被重设；比较轨迹时要保留设定事件和当前值。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_AHRS::set_home(): _home = tmp; _home_is_set = true`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.cpp:2027](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.cpp#L2027-L2027)；输入位置校验并转成 ABSOLUTE 高度帧后写入 Home，再置有效位。 set_home() 失败时不得更新监视器中的 Home。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_MAVLINK::send_home_position()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_Common.cpp:3107](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_Common.cpp#L3107-L3107)；home_is_set() 为真时发送 get_home() 的经纬度、高度和局部向量。 发送时间与 Home 设定时间分开保存。 |
| `Pos_t-1 != Pos_t` | 当前位置与上一观测位置不同。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.lat,lng)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一坐标定义的连续有效样本；严格整数相等不能替代物理静止容差。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。 |
| `ALT_t-1 = ALT_t` | 当前高度与上一观测高度严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `RTL_ALT_M`；默认 `15`，冻结 SITL 值 `15.0`，单位 `m`，范围 `0.30..3000`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.RTL3</strong>：达到返航高度并到达返航参考位置后进入着陆模式。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“-  If you set the :ref:`RTL_ALT_M<RTL_ALT_M>` to a number at other than 0 it will go to and maintain that altitude while returning. -  RTL uses :ref:`WP_SPD<WP_SPD>` to determine how fast it travels. -  Once the copter arrives at the home location the copter will pause for ``RTL_LOIT_TIME`` milliseconds, timeout (AUTO_LAND), then land.”
- 官方位置：[RTL Mode — arrival and loiter](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst#L117-L121)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/rtl-mode.rst:117-121`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = RTL) & (ALT_t >= RTL_ALT) & (Pos_t = home_position)) -> (Mode_t = LAND))`。
- 规范化式：`G(enter_loiter_at_home → (G_[0,T_RTL_LOIT) ¬enter_land ∧ F_[T_RTL_LOIT,∞) enter_land))`。
- 修改理由：到达返航点后先按 RTL_LOIT_TIME 等待，再着陆；论文同一采样点从 RTL 变 LAND 的公式不成立。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = RTL` | 当前飞行模式是返航模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::RTL`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:84](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L84-L84)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::RTL。  |
| `ALT_t >= RTL_ALT` | 当前高度达到或超过 ArduPilot 返航高度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`ModeRTL::altitude_m / RTL_ALT_M`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp:8](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_rtl.cpp#L8-L8)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |
| `Pos_t = home_position` | 当前位置等于返航参考位置。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。<br>主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_home()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:600](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L600-L600)；Home 已设置时读取 AHRS 保存的 Home Location。 要求 home_is_set()；当前 RTL 目的地也可能是 rally point，不能自动把 return target 等同于 Home。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_AHRS::_home, AP_AHRS::_home_is_set`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:857](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L857-L857)；只有 _home_is_set==true 时 _home 才是有效 Home。 Home 可被重设；比较轨迹时要保留设定事件和当前值。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_AHRS::set_home(): _home = tmp; _home_is_set = true`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.cpp:2027](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.cpp#L2027-L2027)；输入位置校验并转成 ABSOLUTE 高度帧后写入 Home，再置有效位。 set_home() 失败时不得更新监视器中的 Home。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_MAVLINK::send_home_position()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_Common.cpp:3107](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS_Common.cpp#L3107-L3107)；home_is_set() 为真时发送 get_home() 的经纬度、高度和局部向量。 发送时间与 Home 设定时间分开保存。 |
| `Mode_t = LAND` | 当前飞行模式是着陆模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::LAND`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:86](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L86-L86)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::LAND。  |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `RTL_ALT_M`；默认 `15`，冻结 SITL 值 `15.0`，单位 `m`，范围 `0.30..3000`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.RTL4</strong>：着陆模式触地后锁定电机。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“-  Upon reaching the ground the copter will automatically shut-down the motors and disarm the copter if the pilot's throttle is at minimum. .. note:: Copter will recognise that it has landed when ALL of the following are true for approximately one second: - Motors are commanded to their lower limit by the vertical position controller - Throttle is at minimum - No large angle is being requested (roll/pitch target < 15°) - No large angle error exists (attitude error < 30°) - The airframe is not accelerating downward > 1m/s/s ( >2 m/s/s if Weight on Wheels feature is enabled) - Vertical speed is within 1 m/s of zero ( within 2 m/s if Weight on Wheels feature is enabled) - If a healthy rangefinder is available, and rangefinder altitude is below 2m - Weight-on-Wheels (WoW) sensor (if present) confirms contact or is unknown Altitude above home is **not** used as a motor shutoff condition (except when a rangefinder is used,see above). The ``LAND_ALT_LOW_M`` parameter (default 10m) only controls the **descent speed transition** from :ref:`LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS<LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS>` to :ref:`LAND_SPD_MS<LAND_SPD_MS>` — it has no role in landing detection or disarming.”
- 官方位置：[Land Mode — landing recognition and disarm](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst#L23-L43)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst:23-43`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = LAND) & (ALT_t = GroundALT)) -> (Disarm = on))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=LAND ∧ landed ∧ throttle_min) → F_[0,∞) disarmed)`。
- 修改理由：触地不能用 ALT=GroundALT 判定；当前说明要求着陆判定及油门最小等条件。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = LAND` | 当前飞行模式是着陆模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::LAND`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:86](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L86-L86)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::LAND。  |
| `ALT_t = GroundALT` | 当前高度严格等于论文所称地面高度。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`no type-compatible numeric GroundALT definition`，无可靠源码位置；论文没有给 GroundALT 的数值类型、坐标参考面或容差，不能把布尔 landed 直接代入数值等式。 补充官方定义或明确把性质重写为 landed 布尔命题前不判真。 |
| `Disarm = on` | 电机处于锁定状态。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`!AP_Motors::armed()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h:117](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h#L117-L117)；Disarm=on 当且仅当 motors->armed()==false。  |

<details><summary><strong>A.FLIP1</strong>：满足横滚、油门、高度和前一模式条件时才允许进入翻滚模式。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“Vehicle will flip on its roll or pitch axis depending upon the pilot's roll and pitch stick position in flight mode's which allow this (ACRO/ALTHOLD/STABILIZE...and,of course, FLIP mode). Vehicle will increase throttle rapidly as it starts to flip. Once the flip is completed, canceled, or times out, the original flight mode the vehicle was in will be restored. The flip will end at the entry attitude. The vehicle will not flip again until the switch is brought low and back to high, if on an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or if the mode channel switch is changed to another mode and back to FLIP. .. warning:: Give yourself at least 10m of altitude before trying flip for the first time! Flip Mode Controls ================== The mode may be entered either by an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or by changing flight mode to FLIP. - The direction of the flip defaults to ROLL LEFT, but if the RC Pitch stick is moved slightly back or forward, it will flip on the pitch axis, back or forward, respectively. If the RC Pitch stick is neutral but the RC ROLL is pushed slightly right, it will flip rolling to the right. - During the flip the throttle is managed to attempt to neither gain or lose altitude. It is only an attempt! - You may abort the flip by moving the pitch or roll stick as if to command near full stick in that axis. The Flip will immediately halt **at whatever attitude it is currently at** and return to the previous flight mode at the pilot's throttle stick input. - As the flip is completing, it will briefly increase throttle to try to recover any lost altitude. Again, this is an approximation. Once completed (entry attitude re-attained), the previous flight mode is returned to (if not entered by an AUX switch). It will not flip again until the Aux Switch is lowered and raised again, if used, or FLIP flight mode re-entered. If entered via a flight mode switch, you will need to change mode out of FLIP, to another mode, and then back again if another flip is desired,”
- 官方位置：[Flip Mode — entry and behavior](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst#L7-L20)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst:7-20`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = FLIP) -> ((Mode_t-1 = ACRO/ALT_HOLD) & !(Roll_t > 45) | (Throttle_t <= 1500) | (ALT_t < 10)))`。
- 规范化式：`G(enter_FLIP → (previous_mode∈allowed_flip_modes ∧ |roll|<45° ∧ armed ∧ ¬landed))`。
- 修改理由：10 米是首次尝试的安全警告，不是进入 FLIP 的充分必要条件；允许进入模式和姿态条件也与论文不同。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = FLIP` | 当前飞行模式是翻滚模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::FLIP`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:89](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L89-L89)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::FLIP。  |
| `Mode_t-1 in {ACRO,ALT_HOLD}` | 上一观测模式是特技或定高模式。 | 建模对应 | 可计算得到 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::flightmode->mode_number())`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只接受同一 sysid/compid 的有序心跳；模式切换期间保留发送/到达时间。<br>主真值：`Mode::Number::ACRO`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:79](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L79-L79)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::ACRO。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::ALT_HOLD`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:80](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L80-L80)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::ALT_HOLD。  |
| `Roll_t > 45deg` | 当前横滚角大于 45 度。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:636](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L636-L636)；读取 AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad() 返回的当前欧拉角。 要求姿态估计有效；角度比较必须处理 ±π 环绕。 |
| `Throttle_t <= 1500` | 当前油门通道值不超过 1500。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_throttle->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的油门通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_throttle = &rc().get_throttle_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:25](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L25-L25)；把逻辑油门功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `ALT_t < 10m` | 当前高度低于 10 米。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |
| `Roll_t < 45deg` | 当前横滚角小于 45 度；该条件来自论文自然语言，不是印刷公式中的同向原子。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:636](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L636-L636)；读取 AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad() 返回的当前欧拉角。 要求姿态估计有效；角度比较必须处理 ±π 环绕。 |
| `Throttle_t >= 1500` | 当前油门通道值达到或超过 1500；该条件来自论文自然语言。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_throttle->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的油门通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_throttle = &rc().get_throttle_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:25](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L25-L25)；把逻辑油门功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `ALT_t > 10m` | 当前高度高于 10 米；该条件来自论文自然语言。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.FLIP2</strong>：翻滚模式特定横滚角区间内向右以每秒 400 度滚转。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“Vehicle will flip on its roll or pitch axis depending upon the pilot's roll and pitch stick position in flight mode's which allow this (ACRO/ALTHOLD/STABILIZE...and,of course, FLIP mode). Vehicle will increase throttle rapidly as it starts to flip. Once the flip is completed, canceled, or times out, the original flight mode the vehicle was in will be restored. The flip will end at the entry attitude. The vehicle will not flip again until the switch is brought low and back to high, if on an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or if the mode channel switch is changed to another mode and back to FLIP. .. warning:: Give yourself at least 10m of altitude before trying flip for the first time! Flip Mode Controls ================== The mode may be entered either by an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or by changing flight mode to FLIP. - The direction of the flip defaults to ROLL LEFT, but if the RC Pitch stick is moved slightly back or forward, it will flip on the pitch axis, back or forward, respectively. If the RC Pitch stick is neutral but the RC ROLL is pushed slightly right, it will flip rolling to the right. - During the flip the throttle is managed to attempt to neither gain or lose altitude. It is only an attempt! - You may abort the flip by moving the pitch or roll stick as if to command near full stick in that axis. The Flip will immediately halt **at whatever attitude it is currently at** and return to the previous flight mode at the pilot's throttle stick input. - As the flip is completing, it will briefly increase throttle to try to recover any lost altitude. Again, this is an approximation. Once completed (entry attitude re-attained), the previous flight mode is returned to (if not entered by an AUX switch). It will not flip again until the Aux Switch is lowered and raised again, if used, or FLIP flight mode re-entered. If entered via a flight mode switch, you will need to change mode out of FLIP, to another mode, and then back again if another flip is desired,”
- 官方位置：[Flip Mode — direction and managed flip](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst#L7-L20)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst:7-20`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = FLIP) & (-90 <= Roll_t <= 45)) -> ((Roll_rate = 400) & (Roll_direction = right)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=FLIP ∧ flip_stage=rotate) → commanded_roll_rate=direction×400°/s)`。
- 修改理由：当前行为仍有翻滚方向和内部约 400 度/秒目标，但论文把内部目标速率写成可直接观测的物理恒等式。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = FLIP` | 当前飞行模式是翻滚模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::FLIP`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:89](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L89-L89)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::FLIP。  |
| `-90deg <= Roll_t <= 45deg` | 当前横滚角位于负 90 度到 45 度之间。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:636](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L636-L636)；读取 AP_AHRS::get_roll_rad() 返回的当前欧拉角。 要求姿态估计有效；角度比较必须处理 ±π 环绕。 |
| `Roll_rate = 400deg/s` | 横滚角速度严格等于每秒 400 度。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`FLIP_ROTATION_RATE_RADS`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp#L23-L23)；若论文指控制请求，则 FLIP Start/Roll 阶段请求值为该常量乘方向。 必须区分控制请求和实际测量角速度。 |
| `Roll_direction = right` | 横滚方向为右。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`ModeFlip::roll_dir`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:995](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L995-L995)；右翻滚当且仅当 roll_dir==1。 只在当前 FLIP 实例初始化后有效。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`ModeFlip::roll_dir = FLIP_ROLL_RIGHT or FLIP_ROLL_LEFT`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp:71](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp#L71-L71)；俯仰摇杆未选择翻转时，根据横滚 control_in 符号写入右翻或左翻常量。 只在 Flip 模式成功初始化后有效。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`FLIP_ROTATION_RATE_RADS * ModeFlip::roll_dir`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp:118](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_flip.cpp#L118-L118)；Start/Roll 阶段把 roll_dir 乘以 400 deg/s 请求传给姿态控制器。 这是指令方向，不是实际角速度轨迹。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.FLIP3</strong>：完成翻滚阶段后在未知 k 时间内恢复原始姿态。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“Vehicle will flip on its roll or pitch axis depending upon the pilot's roll and pitch stick position in flight mode's which allow this (ACRO/ALTHOLD/STABILIZE...and,of course, FLIP mode). Vehicle will increase throttle rapidly as it starts to flip. Once the flip is completed, canceled, or times out, the original flight mode the vehicle was in will be restored. The flip will end at the entry attitude. The vehicle will not flip again until the switch is brought low and back to high, if on an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or if the mode channel switch is changed to another mode and back to FLIP. .. warning:: Give yourself at least 10m of altitude before trying flip for the first time! Flip Mode Controls ================== The mode may be entered either by an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or by changing flight mode to FLIP. - The direction of the flip defaults to ROLL LEFT, but if the RC Pitch stick is moved slightly back or forward, it will flip on the pitch axis, back or forward, respectively. If the RC Pitch stick is neutral but the RC ROLL is pushed slightly right, it will flip rolling to the right. - During the flip the throttle is managed to attempt to neither gain or lose altitude. It is only an attempt! - You may abort the flip by moving the pitch or roll stick as if to command near full stick in that axis. The Flip will immediately halt **at whatever attitude it is currently at** and return to the previous flight mode at the pilot's throttle stick input. - As the flip is completing, it will briefly increase throttle to try to recover any lost altitude. Again, this is an approximation. Once completed (entry attitude re-attained), the previous flight mode is returned to (if not entered by an AUX switch). It will not flip again until the Aux Switch is lowered and raised again, if used, or FLIP flight mode re-entered. If entered via a flight mode switch, you will need to change mode out of FLIP, to another mode, and then back again if another flip is desired,”
- 官方位置：[Flip Mode — recovery](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst#L7-L20)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst:7-20`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = FLIP3) -> ((Roll_t = F_[0,k] Roll_original) & (Pitch_t = F_[0,k] Pitch_original) & (Yaw_t = F_[0,k] Yaw_original)))`。
- 规范化式：`G(enter_flip_recovery → F_[0,∞)(entry_attitude_reached ∧ previous_mode_restored))`。
- 修改理由：当前要求结束于进入姿态并恢复原模式；论文 k 没有当前官方来源，且印刷公式语法错误。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = FLIP3` | 论文内部的 FLIP3 恢复阶段标签成立。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`ModeFlip::_state == FlipState::Recover`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:988](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L988-L988)；把论文阶段标签近似解释为当前 FlipState::Recover。 该对应是版本建模，不是论文证明的同名源码实体。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.FLIPGeneral</strong>：应在 2.5 秒内完成翻滚并恢复原飞行模式。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“Vehicle will flip on its roll or pitch axis depending upon the pilot's roll and pitch stick position in flight mode's which allow this (ACRO/ALTHOLD/STABILIZE...and,of course, FLIP mode). Vehicle will increase throttle rapidly as it starts to flip. Once the flip is completed, canceled, or times out, the original flight mode the vehicle was in will be restored. The flip will end at the entry attitude. The vehicle will not flip again until the switch is brought low and back to high, if on an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or if the mode channel switch is changed to another mode and back to FLIP. .. warning:: Give yourself at least 10m of altitude before trying flip for the first time! Flip Mode Controls ================== The mode may be entered either by an :ref:`Auxiliary Switch <common-auxiliary-functions>`, or by changing flight mode to FLIP. - The direction of the flip defaults to ROLL LEFT, but if the RC Pitch stick is moved slightly back or forward, it will flip on the pitch axis, back or forward, respectively. If the RC Pitch stick is neutral but the RC ROLL is pushed slightly right, it will flip rolling to the right. - During the flip the throttle is managed to attempt to neither gain or lose altitude. It is only an attempt! - You may abort the flip by moving the pitch or roll stick as if to command near full stick in that axis. The Flip will immediately halt **at whatever attitude it is currently at** and return to the previous flight mode at the pilot's throttle stick input. - As the flip is completing, it will briefly increase throttle to try to recover any lost altitude. Again, this is an approximation. Once completed (entry attitude re-attained), the previous flight mode is returned to (if not entered by an AUX switch). It will not flip again until the Aux Switch is lowered and raised again, if used, or FLIP flight mode re-entered. If entered via a flight mode switch, you will need to change mode out of FLIP, to another mode, and then back again if another flip is desired,”
- 官方位置：[Flip Mode — timeout and restore](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst#L7-L20)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/flip-mode.rst:7-20`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = FLIP1) -> F_[0,2.5](Mode_t = FLIP3))`。
- 规范化式：`G(enter_flip_start → F_[0,2.5s](flip_recovery_or_abort ∧ previous_mode_restored))`。
- 修改理由：官网说明超时后恢复原模式；固定 2.5 秒来自当前源码规范性注释与 FLIP_TIMEOUT_MS 常量，属于低于官网的源码注释证据。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

<details><summary><strong>A.ALT_HOLD1</strong>：高度来源为气压计时采用气压计高度而非 GPS 高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“When altitude hold mode (aka AltHold) is selected, the throttle is automatically controlled to maintain the current altitude. Roll, Pitch and yaw operate the same as in :ref:`Stabilize mode <stabilize-mode>` meaning that the pilot directly controls the roll and pitch lean angles and the heading. Automatic altitude hold is a feature of many other flight modes (:ref:`Loiter <loiter-mode>`, :ref:`Sport <sport-mode>`, etc) so the information here pertains to those modes as well. .. note:: The autopilot uses a barometer which measures air pressure as the primary means for determining altitude ("Pressure Altitude") and if the air pressure is changing in your flight area due to extreme weather, the copter will follow the air pressure change rather than actual altitude.  When fitted and enabled, a downward facing rangefinder such as LiDAR or SONAR will automatically provide even more accurate altitude maintenance, up to the limit of the sensor.”
- 官方位置：[Altitude Hold — altitude source](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/altholdmode.rst#L14-L33)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/altholdmode.rst:14-33`。
- 论文原式：`G((ALT_src = Baro) -> ((ALT_t = ALT_Baro) & (ALT_t != ALT_GPS)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=ALT_HOLD ∧ barometer_primary ∧ ¬valid_rangefinder_override) → altitude_control_uses_pressure_altitude)`。
- 修改理由：气压高度是主要高度手段，但启用测距仪后会参与；不能要求融合后 ALT 与气压计精确相等且与 GPS 必不相等。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALT_src = Baro` | 论文抽象的高度来源被标记为气压计。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AP_NavEKF3_core::activeHgtSource`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_core.h:1481](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_core.h#L1481-L1481)；读取当前 EKF3 核实际生效的高度源。 必须知道当前活动 EKF 核；参数配置源不等于运行时实际源。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::getActiveSourceSet(core_index)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h:66](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h#L66-L68)；根据当前 EKF 核索引读取正在使用的源集编号。 必须与同一 core_index 的 getPosZSource() 和 activeHgtSource 配对。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::getPosZSource(core_index)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.cpp:239](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.cpp#L239-L247)；从活动源集读取垂直位置配置，并在没有气压计实例时把 BARO 配置退化为 NONE。 返回的是活动源集的配置选择；selectHeightForFusion() 仍可能按新鲜度和回退规则形成实际 activeHgtSource。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`NavEKF3_core::selectHeightForFusion() -> activeHgtSource`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp:1268](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp#L1268-L1268)；根据当前源集、传感器新鲜度和有效性选择 activeHgtSource，失效时可回退到 BARO。 需要同时保留 core_index、源集和 500 ms 新鲜度分支；500 ms 是当前实现条件，不是论文规范时限。<br>关联证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::SourceZ::BARO`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h:30](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h#L30-L30)；若把 Baro=on 解释为当前高度源，则 activeHgtSource==BARO。 <br>形成/消费/发送证据：`activeHgtSource = AP_NavEKF_Source::SourceZ::BARO`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp:1315](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp#L1315-L1315)；配置源为 BARO 或其他高度源失效回退时，运行字段可被赋为 BARO。 要区分直接选择分支与 fallback_to_baro 分支。 |
| `ALT_t = ALT_Baro` | 当前高度严格等于气压计高度。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`Copter::baro_alt_m`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:461](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L461-L461)；读取 barometer.get_altitude() 更新后的 baro_alt_m。 同时要求 AP_Baro::healthy() 且本周期已更新。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::baro_alt_m = AP_Baro::get_altitude()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/sensors.cpp:8](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/sensors.cpp#L8-L8)；每次读取气压计后，把 AP_Baro::get_altitude() 的结果写入 baro_alt_m。 必须与气压计更新周期和 healthy() 结果一起解释。 |
| `ALT_t != ALT_GPS` | 当前高度不等于 GPS 高度。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`AP_GPS::location().alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h:328](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h#L328-L328)；读取主 GPS 最近定位的 Location.alt。 要求 GPS fix、时间戳和位置字段有效；必须统一到 ALT_t 的高度基准。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.ALT_HOLD2</strong>：定高模式中油门位于中值时保持高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“-  If the throttle stick is in the middle (40% ~ 60%) the vehicle will maintain the current altitude. -  Outside of the mid-throttle deadzone (i.e. below 40% or above 60%) the vehicle will descend or climb depending upon the deflection of the stick.  When the stick is completely down the copter will descend at 2.5m/s and if at the very top it will climb by 2.5m/s.  These speeds can be adjusted with the :ref:`PILOT_SPD_UP<PILOT_SPD_UP>` and :ref:`PILOT_SPD_DN<PILOT_SPD_DN>` parameters. The acceleration used to establish these speeds is set by :ref:`PILOT_ACC_Z<PILOT_ACC_Z>`. -  The size of the deadband can be adjusted with the :ref:`THR_DZ<THR_DZ>` parameter.  This param's value should be between "0" and "400" with "0" meaning no deadband.  "100" would produce a deadband 10% above and below mid throttle (i.e. deadband extends from 40% to 60% throttle stick position).”
- 官方位置：[Altitude Hold — throttle deadzone](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/altholdmode.rst#L43-L53)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/altholdmode.rst:43-53`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = ALT_HOLD) & (Throttle_t = 1500)) -> (ALT_t = ALT_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=ALT_HOLD ∧ throttle_in_runtime_deadzone) → altitude_target_held)`。
- 修改理由：当前要求中杆 40%–60% 死区保持高度，死区可由 THR_DZ 调整；不是仅 PWM=1500。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = ALT_HOLD` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 定高模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::ALT_HOLD`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:80](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L80-L80)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::ALT_HOLD。  |
| `Throttle_t = 1500` | 油门输入严格等于通道中值 1500。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_throttle->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的油门通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_throttle = &rc().get_throttle_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:25](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L25-L25)；把逻辑油门功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `ALT_t-1 = ALT_t` | 当前高度与上一观测高度严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE1</strong>：绕圈模式中俯仰杆向上使半径持续减小到零。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_pitch < 1500) & (Circle_radius_t > 0)) -> (Circle_radius_t < Circle_radius_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ pitch_up ∧ radius>0) → radius_prev>radius)`。
- 修改理由：仅 CIRCLE_OPTIONS 位0启用且无电台失效、无冲突调参时，俯仰杆才调整半径。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_pitch < 1500` | 俯仰遥控输入小于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_pitch->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的俯仰通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_pitch = &rc().get_pitch_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:24](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L24-L24)；把逻辑俯仰功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_radius_t > 0` | 当前绕圈半径为正数。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_radius_m()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L58-L58)；读取当前圆周控制器半径目标；内部 _radius_m 非正时回退到参数半径。 只在当前 CIRCLE 控制器实例初始化并更新时有效。 |
| `Circle_radius_t < Circle_radius_t-1` | 绕圈半径比上一观测减小。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_radius_m()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L58-L58)；读取当前圆周控制器半径目标；内部 _radius_m 非正时回退到参数半径。 只在当前 CIRCLE 控制器实例初始化并更新时有效。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_radius_m())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L58-L58)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一 CIRCLE 实例的有序插桩样本；t-1 不是固定时间间隔。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE2</strong>：绕圈模式中俯仰杆向下使半径增加。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_pitch > 1500)) -> (Circle_radius_t > Circle_radius_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ pitch_down) → radius_prev<radius)`。
- 修改理由：仅 CIRCLE_OPTIONS 位0启用且无电台失效、无冲突调参时，俯仰杆才调整半径。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_pitch > 1500` | 俯仰遥控输入大于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_pitch->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的俯仰通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_pitch = &rc().get_pitch_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:24](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L24-L24)；把逻辑俯仰功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_radius_t > Circle_radius_t-1` | 绕圈半径比上一观测增大。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_radius_m()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L58-L58)；读取当前圆周控制器半径目标；内部 _radius_m 非正时回退到参数半径。 只在当前 CIRCLE 控制器实例初始化并更新时有效。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_radius_m())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L58-L58)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一 CIRCLE 实例的有序插桩样本；t-1 不是固定时间间隔。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE3</strong>：顺时针绕圈时横滚杆向右使速度增加。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_roll > 1500) & (Circle_direction_t = clockwise)) -> (Circle_speed_t > Circle_speed_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ roll_right ∧ clockwise) → rate_prev<rate)`。
- 修改理由：当前要求保留方向相关的角速度变化，但必须加入位0、失效和调参旋钮例外。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_roll > 1500` | 横滚遥控输入大于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_direction_t = clockwise` | 绕圈方向是顺时针。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`sign(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；角速度大于零为顺时针，小于零为逆时针，等于零为停止。 只对当前 CIRCLE 控制目标成立。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AC_Circle::set_rate_degs() sign convention`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:75](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L75-L77)；正目标角速度表示顺时针，负目标角速度表示逆时针。 该约定描述控制目标方向，不证明飞行器实际运动方向。 |
| `Circle_speed_t > Circle_speed_t-1` | 绕圈速度比上一观测增大。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_rate_current()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；若论文 speed 指圆周角速度大小，则取 get_rate_current() 的绝对值。 必须明确它是控制目标角速度，不是由位置轨迹测得的实际线速度。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须都取相同的目标角速度定义及绝对值规则。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE4</strong>：逆时针绕圈时横滚杆向右使速度减小。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_roll > 1500) & (Circle_direction_t = counterclockwise)) -> (Circle_speed_t < Circle_speed_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ roll_right ∧ counterclockwise ∧ rate≠0) → |rate_prev|>|rate|)`。
- 修改理由：当前要求保留方向相关的角速度变化，但必须加入位0、失效和调参旋钮例外。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_roll > 1500` | 横滚遥控输入大于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_direction_t = counterclockwise` | 绕圈方向是逆时针。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`sign(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；角速度大于零为顺时针，小于零为逆时针，等于零为停止。 只对当前 CIRCLE 控制目标成立。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AC_Circle::set_rate_degs() sign convention`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:75](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L75-L77)；正目标角速度表示顺时针，负目标角速度表示逆时针。 该约定描述控制目标方向，不证明飞行器实际运动方向。 |
| `Circle_speed_t < Circle_speed_t-1` | 绕圈速度比上一观测减小。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_rate_current()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；若论文 speed 指圆周角速度大小，则取 get_rate_current() 的绝对值。 必须明确它是控制目标角速度，不是由位置轨迹测得的实际线速度。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须都取相同的目标角速度定义及绝对值规则。 |
