<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE5</strong>：逆时针绕圈时横滚杆向左使速度增加。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_roll < 1500) & (Circle_direction_t = counterclockwise)) -> (Circle_speed_t > Circle_speed_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ roll_left ∧ counterclockwise) → |rate_prev|<|rate|)`。
- 修改理由：当前要求保留方向相关的角速度变化，但必须加入位0、失效和调参旋钮例外。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_roll < 1500` | 横滚遥控输入小于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_direction_t = counterclockwise` | 绕圈方向是逆时针。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`sign(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；角速度大于零为顺时针，小于零为逆时针，等于零为停止。 只对当前 CIRCLE 控制目标成立。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AC_Circle::set_rate_degs() sign convention`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:75](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L75-L77)；正目标角速度表示顺时针，负目标角速度表示逆时针。 该约定描述控制目标方向，不证明飞行器实际运动方向。 |
| `Circle_speed_t > Circle_speed_t-1` | 绕圈速度比上一观测增大。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_rate_current()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；若论文 speed 指圆周角速度大小，则取 get_rate_current() 的绝对值。 必须明确它是控制目标角速度，不是由位置轨迹测得的实际线速度。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须都取相同的目标角速度定义及绝对值规则。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE6</strong>：顺时针绕圈时横滚杆向左使速度减小。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“The circle rate set above can be dynamically adjusted in flight by two methods. The first is the use of RC Channel 6 if the :ref:`TUNE<TUNE>` option is set to 39, with the minimum and maximum circle rates set by :ref:`TUNE_MIN<TUNE_MIN>` and :ref:`TUNE_MAX<TUNE_MAX>`. The other is by enabling bit 0 of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter to allow stick adjustment of radius and speed. Circle Control Option ===================== The :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bitmask parameter controls what actions the pilot can adjust with his sticks and circle mode operation. When bit 0 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the pilot can adjust circle's radius and angular velocity with the control sticks: - Pitch stick up (reducing RC pwm) reduces the radius until it reaches zero. Think moving forward from an FPV perspective. - Pitch stick down (increasing RC pwm) increases the radius. Think moving back from an FPV perspective. - Roll stick right (think clockwise) will increase the speed while moving clockwise, or decrease the speed while moving counterclockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. - Roll stick left (think counterclockwise) will increase the speed while moving counterclockwise, or decrease the speed while moving clockwise until reaching zero, at which point it will stop. Once stopped (rate 0), releasing the roll stick and pushing it again in either direction will begin moving again in the desired direction. So yes, this allows you to completely change the direction on the fly. - Roll stick rate changes are inhibited when CH6 tuning knob is set for circle rate. - All stick changes are inhibited in radio failsafe.(ie if loiter turns was part of a mission that continues when in failsafe) - The above does not actually change the stored circle_rate or circle_radius parameter. Upon rebooting, any stick changes to rate and radius are gone and it will use the parameter values. So users should not have any surprises with every new flight.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — stick adjustment](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L24-L39)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:24-39`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = CIRCLE) & (RC_roll < 1500) & (Circle_direction_t = clockwise)) -> (Circle_speed_t < Circle_speed_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ stick_adjust_enabled ∧ ¬radio_failsafe ∧ roll_left ∧ clockwise ∧ rate≠0) → |rate_prev|>|rate|)`。
- 修改理由：当前要求保留方向相关的角速度变化，但必须加入位0、失效和调参旋钮例外。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_roll < 1500` | 横滚遥控输入小于通道中值。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。 |
| `Circle_direction_t = clockwise` | 绕圈方向是顺时针。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`sign(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；角速度大于零为顺时针，小于零为逆时针，等于零为停止。 只对当前 CIRCLE 控制目标成立。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AC_Circle::set_rate_degs() sign convention`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:75](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L75-L77)；正目标角速度表示顺时针，负目标角速度表示逆时针。 该约定描述控制目标方向，不证明飞行器实际运动方向。 |
| `Circle_speed_t < Circle_speed_t-1` | 绕圈速度比上一观测减小。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AC_Circle::get_rate_current()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；若论文 speed 指圆周角速度大小，则取 get_rate_current() 的绝对值。 必须明确它是控制目标角速度，不是由位置轨迹测得的实际线速度。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AC_Circle::get_rate_current())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h:73](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AC_WPNav/AC_Circle.h#L73-L73)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须都取相同的目标角速度定义及绝对值规则。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.CIRCLE7</strong>：绕圈模式忽略横滚、俯仰、偏航控制，但允许油门改变高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“When bit 1 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the Copter will face the direction of travel as it circles, otherwise, the Copter will point its nose at the center of the circle as it orbits. When bit 2 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the circle's center position will set upon mode entry at the current location, rather than on the perimeter with the center in front of the Copter at the start. When bit 3 is set of the :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` parameter the mount's (if used) ROI aka region of interest will be set on the circle center causing mount to face the circle's center all the times. Other Notes =========== - When :ref:`CIRCLE_OPTIONS<CIRCLE_OPTIONS>` bit 0 is not set, the pilot does not have any control over the roll and pitch but can change the altitude with the throttle stick as in :ref:`altholdmode` or :ref:`loiter-mode`. - The pilot can control the yaw of the copter, but the autopilot will not retake control of the yaw until circle mode is re-engaged.”
- 官方位置：[Circle Mode — pilot controls](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst#L41-L50)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/circle-mode.rst:41-50`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = CIRCLE) -> ((RC_roll_t/RC_pitch_t/RC_yaw_t = RC_roll_t-1/RC_pitch_t-1/RC_yaw_t-1) & ((RC_throttle_t <= RC_throttle_t-1) | (RC_throttle_t >= RC_throttle_t-1))))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=CIRCLE ∧ ¬stick_adjust_enabled) → (roll_pitch_inputs_ignored ∧ yaw_input_allowed ∧ throttle_altitude_control_allowed))`。
- 修改理由：位0未设置时只忽略横滚和俯仰；当前明确允许偏航和油门，因此论文“偏航也不可控”过时。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = CIRCLE` | 当前模式是 ArduPilot 绕圈模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::CIRCLE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:85](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L85-L85)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::CIRCLE。  |
| `RC_roll_t = RC_roll_t-1` | 横滚输入与上一观测严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(channel_roll->get_radio_in())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须来自同一映射通道和来源；RC failsafe 样本不得当作正常输入。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.LAND1</strong>：着陆模式高于 10 米时按 LAND_SPEED_HIGH 参数下降。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“-  descends at :ref:`LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS<LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS>`, if non-zero, (or :ref:`WP_SPD_DN <WP_SPD_DN>` if zero) using the regular Altitude Hold controller. -  the pilot can reposition the vehicle using the pitch and roll sticks unless the :ref:`LAND_REPOSITION <LAND_REPOSITION>` parameter is changed to "0". The throttle stick has no effect by default, although high throttle can cancel landing if enabled via :ref:`PILOT_THR_BHV<PILOT_THR_BHV>`. -  if a rangefinder is being used, or :ref:`TERRAIN_ENABLE<TERRAIN_ENABLE>` =1 and terrain data is available, the descent speed will then switch to :ref:`LAND_SPD_MS<LAND_SPD_MS>` at :ref:`LAND_ALT_LOW_M<LAND_ALT_LOW_M>` altitude (default is 10m) above ground until landing occurs. If neither terrain data or rangefinder data is available, then altitude above HOME will be used for the speed switch point (if reached). -  below 10m the copter should descend at the rate specified in the :ref:`LAND_SPD_MS<LAND_SPD_MS>` parameter which defaults to 50cm/s.”
- 官方位置：[Land Mode — descent stages](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst#L10-L18)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst:10-18`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = LAND) & (ALT_t >= 10) &) -> (Speed_vertical_t = LAND_SPEED_HIGH))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=LAND ∧ above_runtime_land_transition) → descent_target=runtime(LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS or WP_SPD_DN))`。
- 修改理由：当前高低速切换高度由 LAND_ALT_LOW_M 和地形/测距仪可用性决定；参数已改名且默认高速度为0时回退 WP_SPD_DN。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = LAND` | 当前飞行模式是着陆模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::LAND`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:86](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L86-L86)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::LAND。  |
| `ALT_t >= 10m` | 当前高度达到或超过 10 米。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |
| `Speed_vertical_t = LAND_SPEED_HIGH` | 垂直速度严格等于高空着陆速度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_velocity_D(float&)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:308](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L308-L308)；下降速度使用 +velD；上升速度使用 -velD，并要求返回 true。 要求速度估计有效；必须按性质阶段选择上升或下降符号。<br>主真值：`ModeLand::land_speed_high_ms / LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_land.cpp:15](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_land.cpp#L15-L15)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.LAND2</strong>：着陆模式低于 10 米时按 LAND_SPEED 参数下降。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“-  descends at :ref:`LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS<LAND_SPD_HIGH_MS>`, if non-zero, (or :ref:`WP_SPD_DN <WP_SPD_DN>` if zero) using the regular Altitude Hold controller. -  the pilot can reposition the vehicle using the pitch and roll sticks unless the :ref:`LAND_REPOSITION <LAND_REPOSITION>` parameter is changed to "0". The throttle stick has no effect by default, although high throttle can cancel landing if enabled via :ref:`PILOT_THR_BHV<PILOT_THR_BHV>`. -  if a rangefinder is being used, or :ref:`TERRAIN_ENABLE<TERRAIN_ENABLE>` =1 and terrain data is available, the descent speed will then switch to :ref:`LAND_SPD_MS<LAND_SPD_MS>` at :ref:`LAND_ALT_LOW_M<LAND_ALT_LOW_M>` altitude (default is 10m) above ground until landing occurs. If neither terrain data or rangefinder data is available, then altitude above HOME will be used for the speed switch point (if reached). -  below 10m the copter should descend at the rate specified in the :ref:`LAND_SPD_MS<LAND_SPD_MS>` parameter which defaults to 50cm/s.”
- 官方位置：[Land Mode — descent stages](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst#L10-L18)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/land-mode.rst:10-18`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = LAND) & (ALT_t < 10) &) -> (Speed_vertical_t = LAND_SPEED))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=LAND ∧ below_runtime_land_transition) → descent_target=runtime(LAND_SPD_MS))`。
- 修改理由：低速下降仍适用，但切换参考可能是地面、地形或 HOME，不能固定写 10 米和单一坐标。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = LAND` | 当前飞行模式是着陆模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::LAND`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:86](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L86-L86)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::LAND。  |
| `ALT_t < 10m` | 当前高度低于 10 米。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |
| `Speed_vertical_t = LAND_SPEED` | 垂直速度严格等于低空着陆速度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_velocity_D(float&)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:308](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L308-L308)；下降速度使用 +velD；上升速度使用 -velD，并要求返回 true。 要求速度估计有效；必须按性质阶段选择上升或下降符号。<br>主真值：`ModeLand::land_speed_ms / LAND_SPD_MS`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode_land.cpp:6](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode_land.cpp#L6-L6)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `LAND_SPD_MS`；默认 `0.5`，冻结 SITL 值 `0.5`，单位 `m/s`，范围 `0.3..2`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.AUTO1</strong>：自动模式忽略横滚、俯仰和油门输入，但允许偏航覆盖。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“At any time the pilot can retake control from the autopilot by returning the flight mode switch to another flight mode such as Stabilize or Loiter.  If the pilot then switches to AUTO again, by default the mission will resume from the last command unless :ref:`MIS_RESTART <MIS_RESTART>` has been set to "1" in which case the mission will restart from the first command. During the mission the pilot's roll, pitch and throttle inputs are ignored but the yaw can be overridden with the yaw stick.  This allows the pilot to, for example, aim the nose of the copter (which might have a hard mounted camera on it) as the copter flies the mission.  The autopilot will attempt to retake yaw control as the vehicle passes the next waypoint.  The :ref:`AUTO_OPTIONS <AUTO_OPTIONS>` param can be set to always ignore pilot yaw input.”
- 官方位置：[Auto Mode — pilot input](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/auto-mode.rst#L57-L67)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/auto-mode.rst:57-67`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = AUTO) -> ((RC_roll_t/RC_pitch_t/RC_throttle_t = RC_roll_t-1/RC_pitch_t-1/RC_throttle_t-1) & ((RC_yaw_t <= RC_yaw_t-1) | (RC_yaw_t >= RC_yaw_t-1))))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=AUTO) → (roll_pitch_throttle_ignored ∧ (¬AUTO_OPTIONS_ignore_yaw → yaw_override_allowed)))`。
- 修改理由：当前仍忽略滚转、俯仰和油门；偏航能否覆盖受 AUTO_OPTIONS 影响，论文公式还错误地约束输入本身不变化。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = AUTO` | 当前模式是自动任务模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::AUTO`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:81](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L81-L81)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::AUTO。  |
| `RC_roll_t = RC_roll_t-1` | 横滚输入与上一观测严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_roll->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的横滚通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_roll = &rc().get_roll_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:23](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L23-L23)；把逻辑横滚功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(channel_roll->get_radio_in())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须来自同一映射通道和来源；RC failsafe 样本不得当作正常输入。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.BRAKE1</strong>：制动模式中应在未知 k 时间内停止。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“This very simple flight mode simply stops the vehicle as soon as possible.  Once invoked, this mode does not accept any input from the pilot. This mode requires a valid position estimate. Brake mode is subject to acceleration and angle limits imposed by the position and attitude controllers. For more aggressive braking, you can also try increasing :ref:`PSC_JERK_NE <PSC_JERK_NE>`. As an example use case, a value of 15 to 30 works well for a small copter. Overview ======== When switched on, Brake mode will attempt to stop the vehicle as quickly as possible.  Good GPS position, :ref:`low magnetic interference on the compass <common-diagnosing-problems-using-logs_compass_interference>`\ and”
- 官方位置：[Brake Mode — stop as soon as possible](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/brake-mode.rst#L7-L20)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/brake-mode.rst:7-20`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = BRAKE) -> F_[0,k](Pos_t = Pos_t-1))`。
- 规范化式：`G(enter_BRAKE → F_[0,∞) stopped)`。
- 修改理由：当前官方只说尽快停止并受加速度/姿态限制，没有固定上界；论文 12.7 秒是作者仿真经验。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = BRAKE` | 当前模式是制动模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::BRAKE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:92](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L92-L92)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::BRAKE。  |
| `F_[0,k](Pos_t = Pos_t-1)` | 在未知 k 时间内当前位置与上一观测位置相同。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.lat,lng)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一坐标定义的连续有效样本；严格整数相等不能替代物理静止容差。<br>主真值：`no current ArduPilot symbol`，无可靠源码位置；PGFuzz 论文经验上界或调度余量，当前没有可追溯数值。  |

<details><summary><strong>A.DRIFT1</strong>：漂移模式中 GPS 丢失后按 FS_EKF_ACTION 进入着陆或定高模式。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“-  Letting go of the sticks effectively turns on a speed brake in the Pitch axis that slows the copter to a stop over a two second period. -  A copter in Drift Mode with the right stick in the center will loosely hold horizontal position (It will slowly drift in the wind.) -  Pilot’s throttle input controls the average motor speed meaning that constant adjustment of the throttle is required to maintain altitude.  If the pilot puts the throttle completely down the motors will go to their minimum rate (:ref:`MOT_SPIN_MIN <MOT_SPIN_MIN>`) and if the vehicle is flying it will lose attitude control and tumble. -  Drift Mode relies on a valid position estimate, such as GPS, for control. -  If you lose your GPS signal in flight while in Drift Mode, your copter will either land or enter altitude hold based on your :ref:`FS_EKF_ACTION <FS_EKF_ACTION>` setting.”
- 官方位置：[Drift Mode — loss of position estimate](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/drift-mode.rst#L41-L53)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/drift-mode.rst:41-53`。
- 论文原式：`G(((GPS_fail = on) & (Mode_t = DRIFT)) -> F_[0,k](Mode_t = FS_EKF_ACTION))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=DRIFT ∧ position_estimate_lost) → F_[0,∞)(Mode=LAND ∨ Mode=ALT_HOLD))`。
- 修改理由：当前仍说明位置估计丢失后按 FS_EKF_ACTION 进入 LAND 或 ALT_HOLD，但没有官方 k 上界。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GPS_fail = on` | 论文抽象的 GPS 故障保护状态开启。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::failsafe.ekf`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:404](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L404-L404)；只有把论文 GPS_fail 放宽为 EKF 位置估计故障时，才可候选使用 failsafe.ekf。 GPS 丢失不等于 EKF failsafe；其他定位源可继续提供位置。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::failsafe_ekf_event/off_event(): failsafe.ekf = true/false`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp:169](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp#L169-L226)；EKF 方差/位置估计故障事件置位 failsafe.ekf，清除事件再复位。 该状态由 EKF 质量与模式要求形成，不是 GPS 消息丢失专用状态。 |
| `Mode_t = DRIFT` | 当前模式是漂移模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::DRIFT`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:87](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L87-L87)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::DRIFT。  |
| `F_[0,k](Mode_t = FS_EKF_ACTION)` | 在未知 k 时间内模式变成参数 FS_EKF_ACTION 指定的动作。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Parameters::fs_ekf_action / FS_EKF_ACTION`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp:268](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp#L268-L268)；读取当前动作枚举；0 仅报告、1 着陆、2 定高、3 全模式着陆。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。<br>主真值：`no current ArduPilot symbol`，无可靠源码位置；PGFuzz 论文经验上界或调度余量，当前没有可追溯数值。  |

<details><summary><strong>A.LOITER1</strong>：定点盘旋模式保持位置、航向和高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“Loiter Mode automatically attempts to maintain the current location, heading and altitude. The pilot may fly the copter in Loiter mode as if it were in a more manual flight mode but when the sticks are released, the vehicle will slow to a stop and hold position. A good GPS lock, :ref:`low magnetic interference on the compass <common-diagnosing-problems-using-logs_compass_interference>` and :ref:`low vibrations <common-diagnosing-problems-using-logs_vibrations>` are all important in achieving good loiter performance. ..  youtube:: yVAnBQkNJdY :width: 100% :url_parameters: ?start=261 Controls ======== The pilot can control the copter's position with the control sticks. -  Horizontal location can be adjusted with the Roll and Pitch control sticks with the default maximum horizontal speed being 5m/s (see Tuning section below on how to adjust this).  When the pilot releases the sticks the copter will slow to a stop. -  Altitude can be controlled with the Throttle control stick just as in :ref:`AltHold mode <altholdmode_controls>` -  The heading can be set with the Yaw control stick The vehicle can be armed in Loiter mode but only once the GPS has 3D lock and the HDOP has dropped below 1.4.  :ref:`More details on LED patterns here <common-leds-pixhawk>`.”
- 官方位置：[Loiter Mode — released-stick hold](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/loiter-mode.rst#L7-L28)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/loiter-mode.rst:7-28`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = LOITER) -> ((Pos_t = Pos_t-1) & (Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1) & (ALT_t = ALT_t-1)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=LOITER ∧ pilot_sticks_released) → F_[0,∞) hold_current_position_heading_altitude)`。
- 修改理由：只有摇杆释放后才减速并保持；飞手主动输入时位置、高度、航向均可改变。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = LOITER` | 当前模式是定点盘旋模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::LOITER`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:83](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L83-L83)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::LOITER。  |
| `Pos_t = Pos_t-1` | 当前位置与上一观测位置严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.lat,lng)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一坐标定义的连续有效样本；严格整数相等不能替代物理静止容差。 |
| `Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1` | 当前偏航与上一观测严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 可计算得到 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:638](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L638-L638)；读取 AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad() 返回的当前欧拉角。 要求姿态估计有效；角度比较必须处理 ±π 环绕。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:638](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L638-L638)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 使用环形角差并拒绝时间倒序；t-1 是前一有效姿态样本。 |
| `ALT_t-1 = ALT_t` | 当前高度与上一观测高度严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.GUIDED1</strong>：引导模式没有剩余航点时保持位置、航向和高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“This capability allows the pilot to interactively command the copter to travel to a target location by clicking on a point on the Mission Planner Flight Data map. Once the location is reached, the copter will hover at that location, waiting for the next target. Follow Me mode also uses Guided Mode to make the copter”
- 官方位置：[Guided Mode — wait at reached target](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/ac2_guidedmode.rst#L21-L25)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/ac2_guidedmode.rst:21-25`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = GUIDED) & (Waypoint = empty)) -> ((Pos_t = Pos_t-1) & (Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1) & (ALT_t = ALT_t-1)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=GUIDED ∧ guided_target_reached ∧ no_new_target) → hold_at_target U new_target_or_mode_change)`。
- 修改理由：当前语义是到达目标后等待下一个目标，不存在可直接绑定的“Waypoint=empty”状态。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = GUIDED` | 当前模式是外部引导模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::GUIDED`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:82](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L82-L82)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::GUIDED。  |
| `Waypoint = empty` | 论文抽象的航点集合为空。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`no exact current Guided 'waypoint empty' symbol`，无可靠源码位置；论文未定义是任务队列为空、Guided 目标不存在还是目标已经完成。 mission count 不能可靠表示 Guided 当前目标是否为空。 |
| `Pos_t = Pos_t-1` | 当前位置与上一观测位置严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.lat,current_loc.lng`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；当前位置由 current_loc 的纬度和经度组成。 要求 position_ok() 且 AHRS 位置样本新鲜；相等判断必须给距离容差。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.lat,lng)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 只比较同一坐标定义的连续有效样本；严格整数相等不能替代物理静止容差。 |
| `Yaw_t = Yaw_t-1` | 当前偏航与上一观测严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 可计算得到 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:638](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L638-L638)；读取 AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad() 返回的当前欧拉角。 要求姿态估计有效；角度比较必须处理 ±π 环绕。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(AP_AHRS::get_yaw_rad())`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:638](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L638-L638)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 使用环形角差并拒绝时间倒序；t-1 是前一有效姿态样本。 |
| `ALT_t-1 = ALT_t` | 当前高度与上一观测高度严格相等。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。<br>主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。 |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 本条没有可直接对应的公式配置参数；常量或未知 `k` 不能伪装成当前参数。

<details><summary><strong>A.SPORT1</strong>：运动模式按 PILOT_SPEED_UP 参数爬升。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“-  The pilot's roll, pitch and yaw sticks control the rate of rotation of the vehicle so when the sticks are released the vehicle will remain in its current attitude. -  The vehicle will not lean more than 30 degrees (this angle is adjustable with the :ref:`ATC_ANGLE_MAX<ATC_ANGLE_MAX>` parameter) -  The altitude is maintained with the altitude hold controller so the vehicle will attempt to hold its current altitude when the sticks are within the mid-throttle deadzone, which is adjustable with :ref:`THR_DZ<THR_DZ>`. It will climb or descend at up to 2.5m/s (this speed is adjustable with the :ref:`PILOT_SPD_UP<PILOT_SPD_UP>` and :ref:`PILOT_SPD_DN<PILOT_SPD_DN>` parameters). The acceleration used to establish these speeds is set by :ref:`PILOT_ACC_Z<PILOT_ACC_Z>`.”
- 官方位置：[Sport Mode — vertical speed limit](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/sport-mode.rst#L18-L28)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/sport-mode.rst:18-28`。
- 论文原式：`G((Mode_t = SPORT) -> (Speed_vertical_t = PILOT_SPEED_UP))`。
- 规范化式：`G((Mode=SPORT ∧ full_climb_command) → vertical_climb_speed≤runtime(PILOT_SPD_UP))`。
- 修改理由：PILOT_SPD_UP 是最大爬升速率且需上推油门；不是只要 SPORT 模式就始终精确以该速度爬升。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = SPORT` | 当前模式是运动模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::SPORT`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:88](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L88-L88)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::SPORT。  |
| `Speed_vertical_t = PILOT_SPEED_UP` | 垂直速度严格等于飞手上升速度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`AP_AHRS::get_velocity_D(float&)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h:308](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_AHRS/AP_AHRS.h#L308-L308)；下降速度使用 +velD；上升速度使用 -velD，并要求返回 true。 要求速度估计有效；必须按性质阶段选择上升或下降符号。<br>主真值：`ParametersG2::pilot_speed_up_ms / PILOT_SPD_UP`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp:1142](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp#L1142-L1142)；当前运行参数值等于 PARAM 协议读取值。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `PILOT_SPD_UP`；默认 `2.5`，冻结 SITL 值 `2.5`，单位 `m/s`，范围 `0.5..5`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.RC.FS1</strong>：已解锁的特技模式中油门低于阈值时立即锁定。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“The radio failsafe will also trigger if the pilot forces the throttle channel below :ref:`FS_THR_VALUE<FS_THR_VALUE>` from the transmitter. What will happen ================ When a radio failsafe is triggered, the copter can be configured via parameters to do nothing, land immediately, RTL, or SmartRTL.  It can also be configured to bypass the failsafe in an Auto Mode mission, or to continue landing if already in a landing phase. - If the copter is disarmed, no failsafe will take place. - If the copter is armed but has landed, the copter will immediately disarm. - If the copter is armed in Stabilize or Acro modes, and the throttle input is at minimum, and the vehicle is not in :ref:`AirMode<airmode>` then the copter will immediately disarm. - Otherwise, the copter will take the actions as configured in the parameters described below. If the failsafe clears (i.e. transmitter and receiver regain contact) the copter will remain in its failsafe mode. It will **not** automatically return to the flight mode that was active before the failsafe was triggered. This means that if, for example, the vehicle was in Loiter when the failsafe occurred and the flight mode was automatically changed to RTL, even after the transmitter and receiver regained contact, the vehicle would remain in RTL.  If the pilot wished to re-take control in Loiter he/she would need to change your flight mode switch to another position and then back to Loiter.”
- 官方位置：[Radio Failsafe — action exceptions](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/radio-failsafe.rst#L32-L44)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/radio-failsafe.rst:32-44`。
- 论文原式：`G(((Mode_t = ACRO) & (Throttle_t < FS_THR_VALUE)) -> (Disarm = on))`。
- 规范化式：`G((radio_failsafe ∧ armed ∧ ((landed) ∨ (Mode∈{STABILIZE,ACRO} ∧ throttle_min ∧ ¬AirMode))) → F_[0,∞) disarmed)`。
- 修改理由：立即锁定还要求已着陆，或特定人工模式、最小油门且非 AirMode；论文漏掉多项条件。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Mode_t = ACRO` | 当前模式是特技模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::ACRO`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:79](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L79-L79)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::ACRO。  |
| `Throttle_t < FS_THR_VALUE` | 油门输入低于遥控故障保护阈值参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_throttle->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的油门通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_throttle = &rc().get_throttle_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:25](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L25-L25)；把逻辑油门功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。<br>主真值：`Parameters::failsafe_throttle_value / FS_THR_VALUE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp:132](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp#L132-L132)；读取当前低油门故障保护阈值；实际触发还需启用配置及消抖。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |
| `Armed = true` | 飞行器电机已经解锁。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`AP_Motors::armed()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h:117](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h#L117-L117)；Armed=true 当且仅当 motors->armed()==true。  |
| `Disarm = on` | 电机处于锁定状态。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`!AP_Motors::armed()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h:117](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h#L117-L117)；Disarm=on 当且仅当 motors->armed()==false。  |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `FS_THR_VALUE`；默认 `975`，冻结 SITL 值 `975`，单位 `PWM`，范围 `910..1100`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.RC.FS2</strong>：油门低于 FS_THR_VALUE 时开启遥控故障保护。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**有条件必须满足**。
- 官方原文：“When the failsafe will trigger ============================== If enabled and set-up correctly the radio failsafe will trigger if any of these conditions occur for more than :ref:`RC_FS_TIMEOUT<RC_FS_TIMEOUT>` seconds (default = 1 sec): -  The pilot turns off the RC transmitter. -  The vehicle travels outside of RC range and signal is lost. -  RC_OVERRIDES are lost if :ref:`using a GCS only <common-gcs-only-operation>` is being used. -  The receiver loses power (unlikely). -  The wires connecting the receiver to the autopilot are broken (unlikely). The radio failsafe will also trigger if the pilot forces the throttle channel below :ref:`FS_THR_VALUE<FS_THR_VALUE>` from the transmitter. What will happen ================ When a radio failsafe is triggered, the copter can be configured via parameters to do nothing, land immediately, RTL, or SmartRTL.  It can also be configured to bypass the failsafe in an Auto Mode mission, or to continue landing if already in a landing phase. - If the copter is disarmed, no failsafe will take place. - If the copter is armed but has landed, the copter will immediately disarm. - If the copter is armed in Stabilize or Acro modes, and the throttle input is at minimum, and the vehicle is not in :ref:`AirMode<airmode>` then the copter will immediately disarm. - Otherwise, the copter will take the actions as configured in the parameters described below.”
- 官方位置：[Radio Failsafe — trigger](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/radio-failsafe.rst#L20-L42)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/radio-failsafe.rst:20-42`。
- 论文原式：`G((Throttle_t < FS_THR_VALUE) -> (RC_fail = on))`。
- 规范化式：`G((FS_THR_ENABLE ∧ throttle<runtime(FS_THR_VALUE)) → radio_failsafe)`。
- 修改理由：低于 FS_THR_VALUE 仍是触发路径之一；正常信号丢失路径另由 RC_FS_TIMEOUT 控制。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Throttle_t < FS_THR_VALUE` | 油门输入低于遥控故障保护阈值参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::channel_throttle->get_radio_in()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h:96](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h#L96-L96)；论文与 1500 比较时读取映射后的油门通道原始 PWM。 要求 RC 输入有效；通道编号由 RC_MAP 配置确定，不能固定假设物理通道号。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::channel_throttle = &rc().get_throttle_channel()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/radio.cpp:25](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/radio.cpp#L25-L25)；把逻辑油门功能绑定到 RC_Channels 当前映射的通道对象，再由 get_radio_in() 读取原始值。 逻辑功能映射可由 RC_MAP 参数改变；必须在测试开始和参数更新后重新确认。<br>主真值：`Parameters::failsafe_throttle_value / FS_THR_VALUE`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp:132](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp#L132-L132)；读取当前低油门故障保护阈值；实际触发还需启用配置及消抖。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |
| `RC_fail = on` | 遥控故障保护状态开启。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`Copter::failsafe.radio`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:402](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L402-L402)；RC_fail=on 当且仅当 failsafe.radio==true。 低油门路径需连续三次低值；另有无输入超时路径。 |

**公式参数当前对应**

- 论文词项 `未记录` → 当前 `FS_THR_VALUE`；默认 `975`，冻结 SITL 值 `975`，单位 `PWM`，范围 `910..1100`。配置参数可以被设置，但飞行中修改、是否重启、模块何时重新读取均未实测。

<details><summary><strong>A.CHUTE1</strong>：释放降落伞要求电机已解锁、模式允许、没有爬升且高于最低开伞高度。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**需按当前版本改写**。
- 官方原文：“You can disable or enable parachute release using an RC channel/switch: set an ``RCx_OPTION`` to 21. A high position enables parachute release; other positions disable it. If an ``RCx_OPTION`` is set to 23 (Parachute 3Pos), the low position disables parachute release, middle position enables operation, and a high will attempt to force release, as explained above, assuming the enabling conditions described below. When will the parachute deploy? =============================== Automatic parachute release can occur when the vehicle has lost attitude control and has begun falling. The following must all be true for a full 1 second for automatic release to trigger: -  The motors are armed (Copter) or flying (Plane) -  The vehicle is not landed (Copter only) -  The vehicle is not in FLIP or ACRO flight mode (Copter only) -  the roll and/or pitch angle of the vehicle is 30 degrees off from the target lean angle (Copter only) -  the barometer shows the vehicle is not climbing (excessive baro noise CAN prevent release in some cases) (Copter & Plane) -  the vehicle is above the :ref:`CHUTE_ALT_MIN <CHUTE_ALT_MIN>` altitude when loss of control is first detected (Copter only). In a fast descent, the actual release may occur below this altitude. A value of "0" disables this check.”
- 官方位置：[Parachute — automatic release](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/common/source/docs/common-parachute.rst#L124-L137)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/common/source/docs/common-parachute.rst:124-137`。
- 论文原式：`G((Parachute = on) -> ((Armed = true) & (Mode_t notin FLIP/ACRO) & (ALT_t <= ALT_t-1) & (ALT_t > CHUTE_ALT_MIN)))`。
- 规范化式：`G((auto_loss_of_control_start ∧ G_[0,1s] auto_chute_conditions) → F_[1s,1s] parachute_released)`。
- 修改理由：论文把所有释放都写成同一组前置条件；当前必须区分手动与自动释放，自动条件需连续一整秒。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Parachute = on` | 降落伞已经释放。 | 精确对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AP_Parachute::released()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.h:60](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.h#L60-L60)；若 Parachute=on 指实际释放状态，则 released()==true。 必须区分 release_initiated、release_in_progress 和 released。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_Parachute::update(): servo release command`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp:147](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp#L147-L147)；释放类型为伺服且延迟满足后，向降落伞功能通道写入释放 PWM。 这是执行器命令，不等于伞具已经物理展开。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_Relay::set(PARACHUTE, true)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp:153](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp#L153-L153)；释放类型为继电器且实例存在时，向降落伞继电器功能写入 true。 这是继电器执行命令，不等于伞具已经物理展开。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_Parachute::update(): _release_in_progress = true; _released = true`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp:157](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp#L157-L157)；执行伺服或继电器分支后，把释放进行中和已释放锁存位置真。 _released 是进程生命周期内锁存的软件状态，仍不能证明物理伞具已经展开。 |
| `Armed = true` | 飞行器电机已经解锁。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`AP_Motors::armed()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h:117](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Motors/AP_Motors_Class.h#L117-L117)；Armed=true 当且仅当 motors->armed()==true。  |
| `Mode_t notin {FLIP,ACRO}` | 当前模式既不是翻滚也不是特技模式。 | 精确对应 | 可直接观测 | 主真值：`Copter::flightmode->mode_number()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:388](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L388-L388)；读取当前 flightmode 指针指向模式的 mode_number()。 按 HEARTBEAT 产生时间或内部主循环采样时间读取；模式切换确认应使用切换后的状态。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`GCS_Copter::custom_mode()`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp:62](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp#L62-L62)；返回当前 flightmode->mode_number() 的整数编码。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::FLIP`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:89](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L89-L89)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::FLIP。 <br>主真值：`Mode::Number::ACRO`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/mode.h:79](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/mode.h#L79-L79)；Mode_t == Mode::Number::ACRO。  |
| `ALT_t <= ALT_t-1` | 当前高度不高于上一观测高度，即论文所称不在爬升。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`previous_accepted(Copter::current_loc.alt)`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；取同一数据源、同一坐标系的前一个已接受有效样本。 前后样本必须采用相同 Home/原点和缩放；拒绝跨 Home 重设或时间倒序。 |
| `ALT_t > CHUTE_ALT_MIN` | 当前高度高于最低开伞高度参数。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`Copter::current_loc.alt`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:469](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L469-L469)；使用 current_loc 的 ABOVE_HOME 高度并换算为米。 要求 AHRS 高度估计有效、Home/原点转换成功且样本新鲜。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::read_inertia() -> change_alt_frame(ABOVE_HOME) with ABOVE_HOME fallback`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp:37](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/inertia.cpp#L37-L37)；第 27 行先写 ABOVE_ORIGIN；第 37--39 行再转换为 ABOVE_HOME，转换失败或尚无 Home 时显式回写 ABOVE_HOME。 get_relative_position_D_origin_float() 必须成功；还要记录 Home 是否已设置以及转换/回退分支。<br>主真值：`AP_Parachute::_alt_min / CHUTE_ALT_MIN`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp:52](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Parachute/AP_Parachute.cpp#L52-L52)；读取当前最低开伞高度；0 表示禁用高度检查。 在测试开始及参数变更后重新读取实际值；不得把默认值当作不可变运行值。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.GPS.FS1</strong>：检测到的 GPS 卫星少于四颗时触发 GPS 故障保护。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**当前不再适用**。
- 官方原文：“.. warning:: **ARCHIVED ARTICLE** The GPS Failsafe was merged into/replaced by the :ref:`EKF / DCM Check & Failsafe <ekf-inav-failsafe>` in Copter 3.3. Overview ======== The GPS Failsafe is enabled by default but you can enable or disable it on the Mission Planner's Standard Parameter List, by set the FS_GPS_ENABLE parameter to 0 (Disable) or 1 (Land) or 2 (switch to AltHold).  It is highly recommended to leave it enabled and no known reason why it should ever be disabled. If you lose GPS lock or experience a GPS Glitch for 5 seconds while in a mode that requires the GPS (Auto, Guided, Loiter, RTL, Circle, Position or Drift) mode it will initiate a Land (or AltHold if FS_GPS_ENABLE is set to 2).”
- 官方位置：[Archived GPS Failsafe](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/archived-gps-failsafe.rst#L9-L27)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/archived-gps-failsafe.rst:9-27`。
- 论文原式：`G((GPS_fail = on) -> (GPS_count < 4))`。
- 规范化式：`当前不再适用：独立 GPS failsafe 已由 EKF/DCM failsafe 替代。`。
- 修改理由：独立 GPS Failsafe 已在 Copter 3.3 合并/替换为 EKF/DCM 检查，旧卫星数规则不可直接沿用。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GPS_fail = on` | 论文抽象的 GPS 故障保护状态开启。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::failsafe.ekf`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:404](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L404-L404)；只有把论文 GPS_fail 放宽为 EKF 位置估计故障时，才可候选使用 failsafe.ekf。 GPS 丢失不等于 EKF failsafe；其他定位源可继续提供位置。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::failsafe_ekf_event/off_event(): failsafe.ekf = true/false`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp:169](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp#L169-L226)；EKF 方差/位置估计故障事件置位 failsafe.ekf，清除事件再复位。 该状态由 EKF 质量与模式要求形成，不是 GPS 消息丢失专用状态。 |
| `GPS_count < 4` | 可见 GPS 卫星数量少于四。 | 精确对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`AP_GPS::num_sats()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h:401](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_GPS/AP_GPS.h#L401-L401)；读取主 GPS 当前锁定卫星数量。 同时检查 GPS 实例、fix_type 和消息新鲜度。 |

<details><summary><strong>A.GPS.FS2</strong>：GPS 故障保护触发且气压计可用时改用气压计高度来源。</summary>

- 当前规范状态：**当前不再适用**。
- 官方原文：“.. warning:: **ARCHIVED ARTICLE** The GPS Failsafe was merged into/replaced by the :ref:`EKF / DCM Check & Failsafe <ekf-inav-failsafe>` in Copter 3.3. Overview ======== The GPS Failsafe is enabled by default but you can enable or disable it on the Mission Planner's Standard Parameter List, by set the FS_GPS_ENABLE parameter to 0 (Disable) or 1 (Land) or 2 (switch to AltHold).  It is highly recommended to leave it enabled and no known reason why it should ever be disabled. If you lose GPS lock or experience a GPS Glitch for 5 seconds while in a mode that requires the GPS (Auto, Guided, Loiter, RTL, Circle, Position or Drift) mode it will initiate a Land (or AltHold if FS_GPS_ENABLE is set to 2).”
- 官方位置：[Archived GPS Failsafe](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/826ef054a04e23b1ceeb3fb01a4df1d270efebcd/copter/source/docs/archived-gps-failsafe.rst#L9-L27)，本地 `/home/lqq/project/TAFuzz/benchmark/extraction_runs/corpus_sources/ardupilot_wiki/copter/source/docs/archived-gps-failsafe.rst:9-27`。
- 论文原式：`G(((GPS_fail = on) & (Baro = on)) -> (ALT_src = Baro))`。
- 规范化式：`当前不再适用：独立 GPS failsafe 已由 EKF/DCM failsafe 替代。`。
- 修改理由：独立 GPS Failsafe 已被替换；当前高度源切换由估计器逻辑决定，旧性质不再是当前官方要求。
- 实现符合性：**未评估**。

|AP|白话真值条件|对应状态|MAVLink 观测|源码定义、更新、消费或发送位置|
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GPS_fail = on` | 论文抽象的 GPS 故障保护状态开启。 | 无法确认 | 无法确认 | 主真值：`Copter::failsafe.ekf`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/Copter.h:404](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/Copter.h#L404-L404)；只有把论文 GPS_fail 放宽为 EKF 位置估计故障时，才可候选使用 failsafe.ekf。 GPS 丢失不等于 EKF failsafe；其他定位源可继续提供位置。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`Copter::failsafe_ekf_event/off_event(): failsafe.ekf = true/false`，[baseline/ardupilot/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp:169](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/ArduCopter/ekf_check.cpp#L169-L226)；EKF 方差/位置估计故障事件置位 failsafe.ekf，清除事件再复位。 该状态由 EKF 质量与模式要求形成，不是 GPS 消息丢失专用状态。 |
| `Baro = on` | 论文抽象的气压计可用状态开启。 | 建模对应 | 条件可观测 | 主真值：`AP_Baro::healthy()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_Baro/AP_Baro.h:58](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_Baro/AP_Baro.h#L58-L58)；若把 Baro=on 解释为主气压计健康，则 healthy()==true。 该解释不等于气压计被 EKF 选为高度源。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`SYS_STATUS pressure health uses AP_Baro::all_healthy()`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS.cpp:491](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/GCS_MAVLink/GCS.cpp#L491-L491)；SYS_STATUS 的绝对压力健康位只有在所有气压计实例健康时置位。 主值 AP_Baro::healthy() 只检查主实例；所有实例健康与主实例健康不是同一个布尔条件。 |
| `ALT_src = Baro` | 论文抽象的高度来源被标记为气压计。 | 建模对应 | 需要插桩 | 主真值：`AP_NavEKF3_core::activeHgtSource`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_core.h:1481](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_core.h#L1481-L1481)；读取当前 EKF3 核实际生效的高度源。 必须知道当前活动 EKF 核；参数配置源不等于运行时实际源。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::getActiveSourceSet(core_index)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h:66](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h#L66-L68)；根据当前 EKF 核索引读取正在使用的源集编号。 必须与同一 core_index 的 getPosZSource() 和 activeHgtSource 配对。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::getPosZSource(core_index)`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.cpp:239](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.cpp#L239-L247)；从活动源集读取垂直位置配置，并在没有气压计实例时把 BARO 配置退化为 NONE。 返回的是活动源集的配置选择；selectHeightForFusion() 仍可能按新鲜度和回退规则形成实际 activeHgtSource。<br>形成/消费/发送证据：`NavEKF3_core::selectHeightForFusion() -> activeHgtSource`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp:1268](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp#L1268-L1268)；根据当前源集、传感器新鲜度和有效性选择 activeHgtSource，失效时可回退到 BARO。 需要同时保留 core_index、源集和 500 ms 新鲜度分支；500 ms 是当前实现条件，不是论文规范时限。<br>关联证据：`AP_NavEKF_Source::SourceZ::BARO`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h:30](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.h#L30-L30)；若把 Baro=on 解释为当前高度源，则 activeHgtSource==BARO。 <br>形成/消费/发送证据：`activeHgtSource = AP_NavEKF_Source::SourceZ::BARO`，[baseline/ardupilot/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp:1315](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/8f2e5db2efd69e4753b0bacb4d87fbe51566ba6e/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_PosVelFusion.cpp#L1315-L1315)；配置源为 BARO 或其他高度源失效回退时，运行字段可被赋为 BARO。 要区分直接选择分支与 fallback_to_baro 分支。 |

## 统计、审计边界与复核结论

- 表中严格为 30 条：30 个论文编号、30 个论文原样公式、30 个当前状态。
- 当前状态统计：当前仍须满足 0 条；有条件必须满足 10 条；需按当前版本改写 18 条；当前不再适用 2 条；证据不足 0 条。
- 公开 PGFuzz 仓库只有 28 个 ArduPilot 性质目录：`A.FLIPGeneral` 对应 `A.FLIP4`，`A.CHUTE1` 对应 `A.CHUTE`，`A.CIRCLE4/5/6` 共用 `A.CIRCLE4_6`。这解释目录数量，不表示性质被合并为同一逻辑公式。
- PGFuzz 的 `k` 来自仿真响应测量：选择关联输入、满足前置、测响应、对性质取否、重复 100 次，取最大响应时间；A.BRAKE 示例为 12.7 秒。它是论文经验时间，不是当前 ArduPilot 规范。
- 公式中的参数默认值都可能被配置改变；冻结 SITL 值只是一次运行快照。没有参数写入实验时，本文件不声称可在飞行中立即生效。
- 自动检查只验证文件、行号、编号、哈希和结构一致性；没有执行完整模糊测试，也没有判断实现符合性。
